items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: I went to see Ray Charles and a lot of the shows that came to Utica

ctx.x: She seemed to really be behind you.

Yeah, and as far as practicing and all that, and I mean we went to shows and I went to see Ray Charles and a lot of the shows that came to Utica she bought me records, like Lester Young records and John Coltrane records, which I didn’t check out at first. You know I’d put it on and I’d be like well it’s all right. But then later on I’d be like listening to it intently for hours and hours. She definitely was a big influence on my musical world.
That’s nice. Who is your — I don’t know if this would be specific names — who is your competition these days, in the funk world?
